name: CC/SA MEETING - JANUARY 8, 2019 - 7PM
agenda_text:
CC/SA MEETING - JANUARY 8, 2019 - 7PM
CC/SA MEETING - JANUARY 8, 2019 - 7PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, JANUARY 08, 2019
07:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 1445
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM CARRILLO, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, BISHOP AND LOA
4. ADMINISTRATION OF OATH OF OFFICE BY THE HONORABLE JUDGE MARIO BARRERA: * Richard Loa, Councilmember District 2
5. PRESENTATION:
5.1 Presentation by the Grupo Ritual Azteca Del El Sr. De Milagros De PALMDALE who will perform a ceremonial blessing dance called FUEGO.
5.2 Palmdale Animal Care Center representative will present a cute critter that is available for adoption from our local Animal Care Center.
5.3 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a Certificate of Recognition to the High Desert Obedience Club, Pet Pals, for their participation in the “Books and Barks” program that uses therapy dogs at the City of Palmdale Library to encourage kids to read aloud.
5.4 Presentation by Mayor and Council to the Director of Public Works Chuck Heffernan, on behalf of the Department of Public Works, of plaques from the Southern California Chapter of the American Public Works Association (APWA) for the 2018 Project of the Year Award in the Creative and Innovative category for the City’s streetlight acquisition and retrofit project, and presentation to Capital Improvement Project Manager Lynn Glidden who was honored with the President’s Award from the Southern California chapter.
6. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S) and ORDINANCE(S):
Staff Recommendation: Waive full reading of the Resolution(s) and/or Ordinance(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.
7. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON 8 (CONSENT CALENDAR), and 9 (APPOINTMENT).
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under this Consent Calendar by one vote.
8. CONSENT CALENDAR: NOTICE:
8.1 CC - Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale’s books as of November 30, 2018. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale’s books.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.1
8.2 CC - Authorize necessary travel expenditures for Mayor Steve Hofbauer to attend the League of California Cities’ New Mayors & Council Member Academy in Irvine, California, January 29 – February 1, 2019, in the amount of $1,447.60, funded through account 10110001-710001. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
Staff Recommendation: Authorize necessary travel expenditures for Mayor Steve Hofbauer to attend the League of California Cities’ New Mayors & Council Member Academy.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.2
8.3 CC - Authorize necessary travel expenditures for Mayor Pro Tem Juan Carrillo to attend the P3C Conference & Expo in Dallas, Texas on March 3 – 6, 2019, in the amount of $2,060.00, funded through account 10110001-710010. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
Staff Recommendation: Authorize necessary travel expenditures for Mayor Pro Tem Juan Carrillo to attend the P3C Conference & Expo.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.3
8.4 CC - Authorize necessary travel expenditures for Councilmember Richard Loa to attend the League of California Cities’ New Mayors & Council Member Academy in Sacramento, California on January 15 – 18, 2019, in the amount of $2,425.00, funded through account number 10110001-710003. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
Staff Recommendation: Authorize necessary travel expenditures for Councilmember Richard Loa to attend the League of California Cities’ New Mayors & Council Member Academy.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.4
8.5 CC - ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-002, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AUTHORIZING PARTICIPATION IN THE HUD PUBLIC OFFERING AS PART OF THE SECTION 108 LOAN GUARANTEE ASSISTANCE PROGRAM TO REFINANCE THE EXISTING NOTE OR OTHER OBLIGATION IN THE ORIGINAL PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF $4,000,000 FOR THE COURSON SENIOR CENTER. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-002.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.5
8.6 CC - Approve Side Letter of Agreement No. A-5873 between the City of Palmdale and Teamsters Local 911 to reflect changes necessitated by the addition of Sewer Maintenance group and the impacts of the Janus vs. AFSCME decision adoption of SB 866. (Staff Reference: Human Resources Manager Nevarez)
Staff Recommendation: Approve Side Letter of Agreement No. A-5873 between the City of Palmdale and Teamsters Local 911 to add the Sewer Maintenance group.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.6
8.7 CC - Award of Project No. 752, Courson Warehouse ADA Tenant and Sitework Improvement Project to Webb Builders, in the amount of $225,350.00, fund through account number B0004280-724525, Agreement No. A-6488. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Award of Project No. 752, Courson Warehouse ADA Tenant and Sitework Improvement Project to Webb Builders.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.7
8.8 CC - ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-001, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE RATIFYING THE CITY MANAGER ENTERING INTO AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO AGREEMENT A-6116. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-001.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.8
8.9 CC - Approval of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between Los Angeles County and the City of Palmdale, for County implementation of its State-approved Local Agency Management Plan (LAMP) governing the design, operation and maintenance of Onsite Wastewater Treatment Systems (OWTS) within the City, and authorize the City Manager to sign the agreement, Agreement No. A-6532. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Approval of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Los Angeles County.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.9
8.10 SA - Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale’s books as of November 30, 2018. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.10
8.11 SA - ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. SA 2019-001, A RESOLUTION OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING THE RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE (ROPS 19-20) FOR THE PERIOD OF JULY 1, 2019 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2020. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. SA 2019-001 APPROVING THE RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE (ROPS 19-20) FOR THE PERIOD OF JULY 1, 2019 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2020.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.11
8.12 SA - ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. SA 2019-002, A RESOLUTION OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE COMMUNITY REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING THE ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGET FOR THE PERIOD OF JULY 1, 2019 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2020 (ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGET 19-20). (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. SA 2019-002 APPROVING THE ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGET FOR THE PERIOD OF JULY 1, 2019 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2020 (ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGET 19-20).
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.12
9. APPOINTMENT:
9.1 Re-appointment of Helen Velador as the Director/Public Member to serve on the Palmdale Recycled Water Authority for a one-year renewable term to expire in January of 2020. (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
Mayor's nomination is the motion and there is no need for a second.
Staff Recommendation: Re-appoint Director/Public Member Helen Velador to the Palmdale Recycled Water Authority for a one-year renewable term to expire in January of 2020.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 9.1
